items.information: You're asked to have read the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the tutorial at the competition is here to remind them to you! It is very important to attend to at least one of the tutorials so that you can understand how the competition goes and to avoid incidents! The competition is open to all competitors, of all ages and all nationalities!

items.information: The competition is open to all competitors of all ages and nationalities. Competitors should be willing to volunteer as Judges/Scramblers/Runners during the competition.
